messages:
SRE-Bot: pager: high error-rate alert triggered for service=proxy-gateway — spike in 502/504 upstream failures > 8% over 5m :rotating_light: Pager sent to #eng-oncall.
Alex M: Acked. Investigating. Which upstream is spiking?
Maya S: Seeing increased 504 from transitproxy-east and some 502s from transitproxy-west. Traces show timeouts when calling model-shard-03. Also seeing retry storms from SDK clients.
Jamie (oncall): I'm throttling retries at edge for 30s and disabling aggressive 3x retry header for guest traffic. Pushing config: `edge.retry_policy.max_retries=1`
Lee Ops: Rolling that now. Also switching route for model requests to fallback-model-v2 (lower perf but stable) for affected shards.
SRE-Bot: change applied by Jamie. Observed metric: proxy.5xx_rate fell from ~12% to ~6% in 2m.
Alex M: Good. We need to reduce noisy pages — current monitor is `5xx_rate > 5% for 1m` which triggers on short bursts. Propose updating to require sustained window: `>5% for 5m` and a minimum error count of 100.
Maya S: +1. Also add a sustained_count filter so the pager only fires if we see >1 sustained window in a 10m rolling period. And add upstream_id + path to the dashboard for faster triage.
Jamie (oncall): Drafting a Prometheus rule to propose: ```yaml
alert: Proxy5xxSustained
expr: sum(rate(proxy_5xx_total[5m])) / sum(rate(proxy_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05 and increase(proxy_5xx_total[10m]) > 100
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: high
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/proxy-5xx
```
Lee Ops: Also recommend a companion alert on upstream tail latency (p95) for model RPCs: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(upstream_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 1.0` — page but to SRE-ops only.
Alex M: We should also add a synthetic probe hitting model-shard routes every 30s from multiple regions. Tie probe failures to an internal (non-paging) alert first, escalate if probe fails >3 checks.
Maya S: Created follow-up ticket infra/alerts#342: "proxy: probe + alert tuning + dashboard". Owners: eng-sre, eng-runtime. Steps: add probe, update rules, create per-upstream dashboard, and run a 1-week noise audit.
Jamie (oncall): Note for handoff — retry throttle is temporary (1h). Monitor error rate and latency; if stable at <4% for 30m we revert to normal retry policy. I'll hand off to Alex in 30m.
SRE-Bot: Incident marked resolved by Jamie. Summary: upstream transient timeouts -> edge retry storms amplified 5xx rate -> temporary retry throttle + fallback routing applied -> alert recalibration proposed. Duration ~27m. Please update post-incident docs and decide whether to keep any changes.
